name: Ascension
audio: rushing wind, a soaring flute and string melody and a dragon's trumpeting call; no speech
world: The amphitheater is alive: banners and ribbons stream, wind-chimes ring, feathers and leaves spiral, clouds race past below and sunlight sweeps across the stone tiers.

actions.beat: A great gust sweeps across the amphitheater, banners and ribbons streaming and the wind-chimes on the pillars ringing.
{{She}} rises on tiptoe, raising the staff and flinging {{her}} free arm wide as the lyre strings ignite and a spiral of wind lifts {{her}} hair and gown.
Zephyros swoops in beside {{her}} with its wings spread across the sky, and {{she}} turns a joyful, radiant look to the camera as the ribbons settle in the breeze.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
